description: Paginated hand-picked birthday gifts with /dp buyUrls. marketplace=amazon.com returns the US catalog (English, USD or no price, tag sw-fodelsedag-20); amazon.se the Swedish one (tag sw-fodelsedag-21). OpenAPI: getCatalog.

country.description: Optional ISO country of the end user, e.g. US or SE. Used when marketplace is omitted (US → amazon.com).

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US, sv. Optional; amazon.com always answers in English.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (US, English, USD) or amazon.se (Sweden), also accepts us / se. Recommended. If omitted: country, then the request's Accept-Language (en-US → amazon.com), else amazon.se. Never an error when missing.

name: get_catalog
title: Curated gift catalog
